question: What were the results of the company's 2025 financial performance?
answer: The company generated €120 million in revenue in 2025. Revenue increased by 25% compared with 2024. The company also achieved a net profit of €18 million and expanded its workforce by 15%.

sources.title: Annual report
sources.text: Revenue for 2025 amounted to €120 million, compared with €100 million in 2024.

sources.title: Financial statement
sources.text: Net profit for the financial year was €15 million.

sources.title: Workforce report
sources.text: The company employed 460 people at the end of 2025, compared with 400 in 2024.
